scope: Production CPU Pre/Corr/Verlet pressure methods and real JPartsLoad4. Frozen source: not coupled temporal convergence, GPU validation or performance.
restart_scope: All schemes test bitwise in-memory high/low/history/phase restoration. Real PART test covers Symplectic current high/low only. No claim of full solver or exact Verlet restart; production cold restart resets phase/history and plastic history.
helper_scope: SortParticles and RemoveBoundary pressure mapping tested directly; inactive legacy sigma/plastic helper behavior is not refactored or validated.
analytic_reference: p0+low0+steps*dt*float(rate); legacy float recurrence and repeated double reference separately reported. A stagnant high output is not a failure when the low component retains the increment.
